reading:
What the judges love in this lineage is steady across three rounds. First, the sommaire Home: every page is a cell headed by one contents line (lamp, page number, name, dotted leader, count) and the whole line is its key. Interaction, usability, system and style each called it "the best 'where is everything' device yet", and interaction offered it as the leader's lower half. Second, typing on the glass: the question and a block-cursor prompt sit on a big lit tube, and Chat has a lit '>' line. That gave soul 7.8 and 7.5, second only to Desk Terminal, and the r12 lessons call it "the strongest return of the original's soul". They also like each page's own green summary screen, the power-on from a line, Settings numbered 991-999 as a contents page, and the section colour kept to a 2px cap and a number (the skeptic: "truly grounded").

What sank it are faults, not the idea, and they were cited by almost every lens.
- Tracked-caps controls ('+ ADD AN IDEA', 'SEND', 'TELL VERA SOMETHING', EARLIER/LATER). Six lenses in r12, five again in r13.
- Equal cells stretched half-empty (Memory, Wishes, Restaurants, the Status and Chat plates), so it read as "a wall of boxes" or a widget dashboard.
- Ideas and To do set as tall card grids, with titles wrapping in 285px cells, and 46px plate titles wrapping too.
- Brass warmth (the accent #e3cd88 on every household cap and number).
- The nav in two places, with no key row on Home.
- Screens that repeat their cells.
- The family's typed words in green VT323, so the box reads as display text.
- No late marking on To do, filters below the radar, and 8 to 20 small targets a page.

In r13 it slid to 6.74 because Folio Switchboard and Desk Terminal did its best things better. Type was always its weakest lens (6.1 to 6.5).

To win, it must stay recognisably the map with the question on the glass, and fix those faults with its own vocabulary:
- The contents line becomes the one row drawing on every page.
- Cells are sized to their content.
- Each screen says what its cells cannot (late count, next due, spend, how the weeks fill).
- Brass is replaced by bone.
- There is one nav, the family types in Plex on a glass well, and late shows in amber words.
- The original tube light comes back only on the phosphor list: the mark, the lit word, Send, the typed box, the tubes, lamps, focus, and the terminal's pool on the panel.

No title has been tried in this lineage yet. Both briefs replace 'What's on your mind?'.

briefs.name: Switchboard, Trued
briefs.hypothesis: The panel already ranks this Home as the best map of the app, and soul ranks its typed-on-glass terminal second in the tournament. It lost on fixable faults, each named by five to seven lenses: caps keys, empty equal cells, card lists, brass, two navs, VT323 input, no late on To do, and wrapping 46px titles. Those faults kept type at about 6.2 and usability at 6.2 to 6.8. Fixing them in the lineage's own terms keeps every loved device and removes every repeated complaint. That should lift it from about 7.0 to the leaders' 8s as the one tour design whose Home maps the whole service. The terms are: the contents line as the single row drawing on every page, cells sized to their content, one page module on inner pages, and the phosphor relit only where the machine is.
briefs.brief:
Start from r12-wmut-1 (copy palettes/r12-wmut-1.json and variants/r12-wmut-1/).

GLOBAL SYSTEM

1. Colour tokens (palette JSON)
- accent #e3cd88 (brass) becomes bone #cdc6b5 (C about 0.02). It carries the household sections (Home, Vera, Memory, Family, Status, Settings): their caps, icons and figures. Check it stays at least 12 dE from people.
- wash becomes #cdc6b5 or is dropped.
- No brass anywhere. Page numbers use --label (#a9b4af).
- people amber (#eaa76b) now means only late or needs a look.
- New tokens --here #5f7689 and --here-cap #a9c4d8 for the current place.
- Keep brand and screen at #6dff9c, glow, screenGlow and topGlow at 1.0, and the graphite surfaces as they are.
- The setup cell is a slate surface with a 2px amber cap and amber bar lamps. Never an amber or olive fill.

2. Type (three faces, as now)
- Plex Sans for the family's words, Plex Mono for figures and legends, VT323 on glass only.
- Written steps: label 12px (Plex Mono caps, +0.06em, legends and column heads only); small 15; body 17/1.55; item 19 (semi-condensed 600); cell 23 (semi-condensed 600); figure 32 (condensed 500, tabular); page title 2rem (condensed 600, down from --t-title 2.875rem, so 'Silver Falls hike' and 'Things to do' never break in the 285px column).
- Every control is sentence case Plex Sans 600 at 15-16px with no tracking: .button, .cell-key, .send ('Send'), month-nav ('Earlier', 'Later'), 'Connect the calendar', 'Add it', 'Cancel', 'Add an idea', 'Tell Vera something'. Remove text-transform and letter-spacing from those selectors.
- text-wrap: balance on h1 and h2, pretty on p. Tabular numerals on every count, time and date.
- Dates in words ('Thu 1 Oct'), never ISO.

3. One nav: row zero
- Delete the second key row (.places under .bar) at 48rem and wider, and use it on no page.
- Row zero (.bar, 88% translucent over the E6 top haze): the mark with its bloom and 8-blink caret (E2), then Home, Vera, Ideas, Plans, To do, Wishes as 44px keys (icon in section colour, word in bone), a hairline divider, then Memory, Family, Status and the Settings menu in words.
- The current key is a steel reverse cell (--here fill, 2px --here-cap top edge, bone ink) with a 5px #6dff9c LED glowing in its top-right corner (L140, from its own ancestor Videotex Sommaire: r11-wild-4 sheet.css 339-349). Only the current key shows its page number, in 12px mono after the word.
- Delete .page-code ('P100 · SOMMAIRE') and every .plate-code ('P300') tile.
- On the phone, the six places stay the Fastext foot row (current key reverse plus LED), and the household tools are icons with aria-labels in row zero.

4. One lamp code, with a key
- On: 10px #6dff9c disc with a white-hot core and 8px and 18px halos, breathing 3.2s (E20).
- Waiting: 7px steel dot.
- Off or not set up: 10px pewter ring (2px #8794a2), replacing today's red rings.
- Needs a look or late: 12x5 amber bar.
- Red only when something has stopped.
- A one-line key ('● On · Waiting ○ Off ▬ Needs a look') sits in Home's foot and in Status's module (lessons r13 principle (b), L260).

5. The contents line is the one row drawing
- Every list row in the app is: lamp slot, number or date in tabular mono, name (17-19px 600), dotted leader only where a fact follows, then right-aligned facts in fixed sub-columns. Min-height 44px, and the whole row is the link.
- The leader is capped at about 46rem.
- Hover and focus light a row at once with a 12% steel wash and a 2px inset edge in the section colour, fading over 1.2s (L228, r13-mut-3 sheet.css 72, 1267-1271). It must show in the motion-glow capture of Home's first idea row.

6. Light: the phosphor list only (phosphor_kit.md)
- E1: the two-layer halo on the lit word.
- E3: ring and pool on the one primary per view.
- E4: the typed well's lit edge and caret, with a 3px ring and 22px bloom on focus, fading 1.2s.
- E5: 2px #6dff9c focus 3px off, including selects.
- E10: a contents link landing on #coming or #todo-list flashes and fades 1.8s.
- E12 to E17 on every tube: screenGlow 1.0, bloom, 0.35px blur, scanlines, sheen, vignette, radar sweep and blip halos, power-on from a line starting at opacity 0.05.
- E19: her glyph screen.
- E8: 3.5% top-edge highlight on cells.
- Nothing else glows. No glow on cells, titles, kind words or numbers.

HOME (P100)

.map layout
- grid-auto-rows: min-content, never minmax(var(--cell), auto). Four columns, 8px seams.
- Row 1: the terminal (cols 1-2, rows 1-2), then 'Finish setting up' (cols 3-4, the first and widest slot while steps remain). It has an amber cap, an amber bar lamp and the count '3', and its three steps are one-line 44px links numbered 1-3.
- Row 2: 400 Plans (cols 3-4). Its label is 'After Next up' (not 'Coming up', which read as 5 plans over 4 rows). Its rows: 'Thu 1 Oct' in a 7ch tabular column, title, leader, '10:00', 'in 2 days'. The source note sits in 15px under the rows. With no setup, Plans takes rows 1-2 and shows five rows (.map:not(:has(.setup))).
- Row 3: 500 To do (cols 1-2). The head reads '4 · 2 late', with '2 late' in amber words. Column heads are Who and Due. Rows: a 44px tick (amber-ringed when late, L255), the title on one line, leader, owner, then due in words ('was due 2 days ago' in amber).
- Row 3, beside it: 300 Ideas (cols 3-4). Rows: kind icon in the kind colour, title, leader, 'for Maya, Theo', and the kind word in its colour in sentence case. Under the rows, the 310 cell is folded into one line: 'Restaurants · 2 to try →'. Then an 'Add an idea' link.
- Row 4: four short key cells, each a contents line plus one line. 600 Wishes: 'Maya 0 open', 'Theo 0 open' as 44px links. 700 Memory: 'Tell Vera something' link. 800 Family: bone initial squares inline. 900 Status: 'Answering / Telegram / Calendar' with the four-signal lamps.
- Row 5: 990 Settings (cols 1-4) as a mini sommaire. The head reads '9 · 1 needs a look'. Then the nine parts as numbered 44px contents rows in three columns, with 998 first and its amber bar.
- Drop every .cell-art pixel pictogram from the cells.

The terminal (.minitel) is page 200 on the map
- The case's top line is her contents line: her glyph screen, '200' in label mono, 'Vera', the date, and the power LED.
- The glass is sized to its content (align-self: start, no flex:1 stretch, so the 100px of empty glass goes). From the top:
  - The inverse NEXT UP legend with a breathing lamp.
  - The plan at --t-tube-l, then when, then [TODAY].
  - '> 4 more on the radar', which jumps to #coming.
  - The radar at clamp(10rem,18vw,14rem).
  - Her last line, clamped to two lines, with '> Continue with Vera'.
  - A dashed rule, then the question at --t-tube-l (2.6rem, up from 2rem), so it is Home's largest head. The apostrophe is set in a Plex Mono span (.apos) at the tube size with the tube's halo, which ends the VT323 tall tick the judges faulted three rounds running.
  - The field: a glass-tinted well (#07110b, 1px phosphor-30% edge), with the typed words and placeholder in Plex Sans 17px (bone ink, placeholder #86a894), and a lit #6dff9c caret. The VT323 '>' prompt comes first, with its block cursor blinking 10 times while the well is empty.
- The deck on the case: From (44px select), 'Send where I am' (44px hit), mic, and 'Send' (the one lit primary, E3). Under the deck are the three ways to start as numbered graphite keys 1-3, 44px, with 8px gaps. The number sits in a sunk bone square and is not lit.
- The case spills an 80px phosphor pool onto the panel (E12). E7's scanlined underglow sits only in the case's lower-left inside the pool, which returns the lit pool from below that the judges said the leaders lost.

Phone Home
- Order: terminal, deck, ways to start, setup, Plans, To do, Ideas, then the key cells and Settings, full width, with Fastext keys at the foot.

INNER PAGES: the rack opens with one object
- .board > .side becomes one graphite module with the page's 2px section cap. It holds, in order:
  - the plate: page number 12px, title 2rem, lede 15px
  - the page's one green primary (full width, sentence case)
  - the page's tools (search, one bank of latched 44px keys per filter, steel reverse plus LED when latched; never a select beside keys for the same filter)
  - the page's green screen, set into the module and sized to its content
- The module is position: sticky under the bar when it fits (@media (min-height: 50rem)).
- Columns 2-4 hold the register: one wide cell of contents-line rows under column heads. Card grids (.idea-card cells, the To do cards) go.

Ideas (300)
- Tools: search, then a two-up bank of kind keys (All, then each kind with its icon, Restaurants among them). The All/Restaurants tabs and the Kind select go. Status and For sit in a 'More filters' fold.
- Screen: the radar with nearest and furthest, which it already does well.
- Register columns: #, Idea (icon plus title), Kind (word in its colour), For, By road ('27 min S', tabular right). About 12 rows above the fold.

Plans (400)
- Tools: List and Month keys. 'Connect the calendar' is a secondary key.
- Screen: four week bars in characters ('Wk 40 ##  2'), with 'Next free weekend 10-11 Oct' when it can be derived from the entries' chips and config.FAMILYDB_APP.clock.today(); otherwise the bars alone.
- Month: day numerals in Plex Mono 500 17px tabular. Today is a steel reverse leaf with a lit lamp, not amber. Past days step back. Weekend columns are faintly shaded. The month name is 2rem bone.
- List: one-line date rows.

To do (500)
- Tools: an Open/Done/Cancelled/All latched 2x2 bank, which replaces the Show select, and search, all above the screen.
- Screen: late, this week, later and no-date bars in characters, late in amber on the glass, each row a link to ?when=... Then 'Next due: Buy Maya's birthday present, Thu 1 Oct'. Compute late with the recipe in tour/t1-b/variants/r13-idea-1/templates/tasks.html lines 28-60 and 136-137.
- Register rows: tick (amber ring when late), '#4', title, Who, Due in words (amber 'was due ...'), and an 'Edit' link (44px) whose fold opens across the full row.

Chat (200)
- Module: plate and the kids' conversation keys.
- Thread: family on the right in steel bubbles with a 3px steel edge, Vera on the left on green-black glass with her glyph. The time sits at each bubble in 12px mono, sentence case.
- Composer: a docked glass line with the lit '>' and the Plex 17px typed words, then the deck. On the phone it collapses to glass line plus Send until :focus-within.

Status (900)
- Module: plate, the spend tube, and the lamp key.
- Register: Who answers, Keys and Connected to as three min-content cells with four-signal lamps, then 'What it has cost' with tabular figures.

Settings (990)
- Replace the nine cards with a sommaire of 56px contents rows: lamp (amber bar when it needs a look), 991, icon, 'General' at 19px 600, leader, the state in 15px ink-2 ('Vancouver, WA · °C and km'), and →. Setup is the first row while it has steps.
- The screen keeps 'How it stands'.

Form (New idea)
- The plate carries the crumbs.
- Fields 44px in Plex 17px. Mono caps labels are allowed as legends.
- 'Add it' is the primary, 'Cancel' is quiet. Selects get the 2px brand focus ring.

Family, Memory, Wishes
- No screen, because nothing is live. The module holds only the plate and its action. Rows are contents lines.

MOTION AND ACCESS
- Cells come up in reading order 50ms apart (L234, its own) and tubes power on. All of it stops under reduced motion.
- MC and FC blocks as in phosphor_kit.md Access, plus .crt-tube > :not(.radar){filter:none} under more contrast.
- Zero targets under 44px.
briefs.borrows:
Judges' fixes, most-cited first:
1. Sentence-case controls, never tracked caps: r12 feedback, system, interaction, type, usability, skeptic; r13 system, interaction, type, usability, skeptic; Folio's panel.
2. Cells sized to content, empty cells collapsed or spanned (grid-auto-rows:min-content): r12 feedback, soul, style, system, interaction, skeptic; r13 feedback, style, system, skeptic.
3. One-line rows to a facts column instead of the Ideas and To do cards: feedback, system, type, usability, skeptic; r13 system and type.
4. One nav on every page including Home: feedback, system, interaction, usability, skeptic; r13 interaction.
5. Brass quieted. Here it is bone, and amber is kept for late: feedback, soul, system, skeptic; lessons r12 'brass kept to page numbers at most'; lessons r13 'wheat or bone for figures'.
6. Screens say what cells don't (late count, next due, spend, weeks): soul, skeptic, lessons r12 FAILED REACHES.
7. The typed words in Plex on a glass-tinted well: interaction and usability in r12 and r13; lessons r12 'typing on the glass', cost 3.
8. Late on To do in amber words: usability r12 and r13; interaction r13.
9. Plate title 46px to 32px: type; lessons.
10. Filters above the screen on Ideas and To do: usability, interaction.
11. Setup in the first and widest slot: interaction; lessons.
12. The Home tube sized to content, and the question as Home's largest head: soul; lessons r12 (1).
13. 44px targets, including the Settings rows and idea links: interaction.
14. Page numbers at the label step, quiet, and the P-tiles dropped: type, skeptic.
15. One hairline per cell, the cap on Home cells only, plate and screen merged into one module: style.
16. Green focus ring on the select: interaction.
17. Pictograms dropped from the cells: soul and style r13 ('kiosk', 'costume').

Phosphor light brought back per phosphor_kit.md: E1-E10, E12-E17, E19-E21, with E7's underglow and E12's pool on the terminal.

Small borrows that answer faults:
- L140 LED on the current key (its own ancestor, r11-wild-4 sheet.css 332-349).
- L260 four signals with a key (r13-mut-2 mapped.css 16-68, which every lens asked to graft).
- L228 the row afterglow that shows (r13-mut-3 sheet.css 72, 1267-1271).
- L255 amber tick box (r10-mut-4 css).
- The late computation from tour/t1-b/variants/r13-idea-1/templates/tasks.html 28-60.

briefs.title: What’s the *plan*? (typed on the glass at --t-tube-l, with 'plan' in the two-layer E1 halo; the apostrophe is a Plex Mono span so VT323's tall tick is gone). It keeps the cadence of the words the family knows ('What's on your...?'), so the line on the glass still reads as the same machine asking. 'Plan' is FamilyDB's job in one word: weekends, outings, the calendar, reminders and the lists are all plans. It is also what a family says to each other at breakfast ('so what's the plan?'), so it invites telling Vera anything. At 16 characters it fits one line of the phone's tube. It is the lineage's first title, improving on 'What's on your mind?', which did not name the job.

briefs.name: Switchboard, Lamp-lit
briefs.hypothesis: The switchboard's pictures were called costume and its cells empty. Its strongest lenses, soul and style, both asked for light that means something. The graft turns every cell's picture into a separated-block videotex mosaic whose blocks are the cell's own data, with at most one lit block when something is live. It opens Status on a lamp strip with its tally, sets every tube as true terminal lines with double-height heads, and draws every dropdown as a numbered videotex choice list. Then the map is at once the most glanceable Home (a picture per page that counts) and the most period-true light, all built from videotex and switchboard parts. With the lineage's universal fixes (sentence case, min-content rows, one-line registers, late in words, 44px, bone for brass) it should beat the carried design on soul, style and interaction, and differ clearly from the refinement, which empties the cells of pictures.
briefs.brief:
Start from r12-wmut-1 (copy palettes/r12-wmut-1.json and variants/r12-wmut-1/). The idea stays recognisable at a glance: the rack of cells, each headed by its contents line, and the question typed on the terminal's glass.

FOUR GRAFTED FEATURES, rebuilt in the switchboard's graphite, bone and 2px caps

1. Data mosaics (L085, gem, from r12-wild-2 Ceefax Evening)
- New macro figure_mosaic(cols, rows, blocks) in _ui.html, replacing mosaic() and kind_mosaic() (_ui.html L36-44), .cell-art and .plate-art .mosaic. It is inline SVG <rect>s: 6px blocks, 2px gaps, shape-rendering crispEdges, aria-hidden, 48-64px, at each Home cell's lower right and at 64px in each plate beside the title.
- Three tones:
  - Empty blocks: the section colour at 30%.
  - Data blocks: the section colour, matte.
  - At most ONE live block per mosaic: #6dff9c with a 3px and 8px halo, breathing, and only when something is live now.
- The data, per picture:
  - 400 Plans: a 7x4 calendar of the next 28 days, a block per day. Days with a plan in plans blue. Today lit if a plan is today. Empty weekend blocks at 45% against 30% on weekdays. Compute the days from each entry's chip and config.FAMILYDB_APP.clock.today() as r13-idea-1/templates/tasks.html does; if that proves fragile, one block per plan in order.
  - 500 To do: a clipboard of bar rows, one per open task up to 6. Amber for late, teal when due, dim when undated. The live block marks one due today.
  - 300 Ideas: a bulb of up to 16 blocks, one per idea. The newest four are in their kind colours, the rest dim lilac. A block breathes while its idea waits to be looked up (idea.pending).
  - 600 Wishes: a gift of one block per open wish, with an amber bar block when waiting on a parent.
  - 800 Family: a block figure per member, in bone.
  - 990 Settings: 3x3, one block per part, amber for needs a look.
  - 200 Vera: her glyph screen (E19) is her picture.
  - 700 Memory: nothing, because the view passes no data. It becomes a half-height cell (contents line plus 'Tell Vera something').
- Each picture's meaning is also in words in the cell, for example 'Next 4 weeks: 5 plans, 3 weekends free' under Plans when derivable.

2. Lamp strip with its tally (L143, gem, from r12-wild-4 Single Quote)
- On the Status page, under the spend tube in the Status module: a recessed black well (#07090a, inset 0 1px 3px #000a) holding 13 lamps in three banks divided by 1px pewter rules (Who answers 4 | Keys 4 | Connected to 5), in the order of the lists.
- Each lamp is an <a href="#row-…"> with the row's name in aria-label and title, and a 44px hit.
- Under the well, the tally '6 working · 7 off' in IBM Plex Sans Condensed 600 at 2rem, tabular, with lamp glyphs before each figure.
- Lamps use one code: on is the lit lamp, not set up is a pewter ring, needs a look is an amber bar, red only when stopped. This replaces the red off-rings.
- Home's 900 Status cell: a strip of the lamps Home knows (Answering, Telegram, Calendar, and 'Needs attention' when status_words exist), with the tally as its contents-line count ('1 on · 2 off').
- Settings uses the same grammar: nine lamps and '8 set · 1 needs a look' on its plate and its Home cell.

3. The glass set as a terminal's lines (L166, gem, from r13-mut-1 Track Diagram, Monospaced)
- Every .crt-tube gets --cell (Home terminal 1.5rem, module screens 1.25rem, phone 1.25rem and 1.1rem), line-height 1, rows at the cell pitch, letter-spacing 0, gaps as whole blank rows (margin-top 1em), .inverse padded exactly 1ch, and the block cursor one cell wide.
- Double-height lines (font-size 2em): Home's question (now Home's largest head), Next up's plan title, the Status spend figure, the Plans screen's count, and To do's late count (in amber on the glass, as L070 did).
- The slashed zero never goes on the glass.
- The family's typed words stay OFF VT323: a glass-tinted well under the question (#07110b, 1px phosphor-30% edge), Plex Sans 17px bone, a lit #6dff9c caret, and the VT323 '>' with its blinking block before it.

4. Numbered choice lists (L055, gem, from r13-wild-1 Phosphor Blueprint)
- In @supports (appearance: base-select): every select's ::picker(select) is a graphite dialog (surface-2, 1px line-2 frame, a 2px cap in the page's section colour, a deep shadow).
- Its options are 44px ruled rows keyed '01', '02', '03' in Plex Mono 12px label ink (a CSS counter), as the service numbers its pages.
- The chosen row's option::checkmark is a lit #6dff9c block, the only light in the list. The pointed or keyboard row is a steel reverse bar (#5f7689, bone ink).
- The closed face keeps its chevron and the 2px #6dff9c focus ring.
- It applies to 'who is asking?' on Home and Chat, Ideas' Status and For, the form's 'Suggested by' and the settings selects. Check controls-select.png: the parent's base-select already renders there.

LAYOUT AND THE LINEAGE'S FIXES

Nav
- One key row, on every page including Home, holds every place. It is the Fastext row under row zero: Home, Vera, Ideas, Plans, To do, Wishes (about 125px each), then Memory, Family, Status (narrower).
- Each key: icon in its section colour, word in bone, page number in 12px label mono, a 2px section-colour cap.
- The current key is a steel reverse cell with a lit 5px LED in its top-right corner (L140).
- Row zero keeps only the mark (E2 bloom, 8-blink caret), the name and the Settings/You menu.
- Delete .page-code 'P100 · SOMMAIRE' and the .plate-code P-tiles.

Home (.map, 4 columns, grid-auto-rows: min-content)
- Rows 1-2: the terminal (cols 1-2). Setup (cols 3-4, row 1, first and widest while steps remain; slate, amber cap, three one-line 44px steps). 400 Plans (cols 3-4, row 2, three one-line rows 'Thu 1 Oct · title · 10:00 · in 2 days' plus its calendar mosaic).
- Row 3: 500 To do (cols 1-2, one-line rows: tick with an amber ring when late, title, Who, Due in words with 'was due …' in amber, plus its mosaic). 300 Ideas (col 3, three rows plus a folded 'Restaurants · 2 to try' line and 'Add an idea'). 200 Vera (col 4, the ways to start as numbered keys 1-3, 44px, 8px apart, her glyph screen lit while she answers).
- Row 4: 600 Wishes, 700 Memory (half height), 800 Family, 900 Status (lamp strip).
- Row 5: 990 Settings (col 4, or cols 3-4), numbered part rows with the lamp tally.
- Cells in one row are kept to a similar content height, so nothing stands empty.
- Accent brass #e3cd88 becomes bone #cdc6b5. Amber (#eaa76b) is kept for late and needs a look.
- Caps: 2px on Home cells only; one hairline border.

The terminal glass, top to bottom, on the cell grid
- The inverse 'NEXT UP' legend with a breathing lamp.
- The plan title at double height, the when line, '> 4 more on the radar'.
- The radar at right (E17 at full).
- A blank row, her last line (two lines) and '> Continue with Vera'.
- A dashed rule, then the question at double height with 'next' lit (E1 halo on top of the tube's bloom).
- The Plex well.
- The glass is sized to its content, with no stretched empty glass.
- The deck on the case: From (a numbered choice list), 'Send where I am', mic, and 'Send' (the one lit primary, E3). The case spills an 80px phosphor pool (E12).

Inner pages (the rack)
- Column 1 is one module: page number 12px, title 2rem condensed 600, lede, the one sentence-case primary, the tools (search and latched key banks, above the screen), then the page's green screen on the cell grid (with its double-height figure), and the page's data mosaic beside the title.
- Columns 2-4 hold a register of one-line rows under column heads, replacing the idea and task cards:

briefs.title: What comes *next*? (typed on the glass at double height, the largest head on Home, with 'next' in the E1 two-layer halo over the tube's bloom). FamilyDB's job is what comes next for the family: this weekend's outing, the plan on the calendar, the reminder, the thing to buy, the wish. The question sits one blank row under the lit NEXT UP legend on the same glass, so the screen shows what is next and then asks the family to add to it. That is the switchboard's own loop, the machine showing and the family telling. 'Next' is also the videotex terminal's own key (the Minitel's Suite). It has no apostrophe, so VT323's tall tick cannot show at double height. At 16 characters it fits one line of the phone's tube (a 1.1rem cell doubled is about 230px). It differs from the refinement's 'What's the plan?', so the judges can compare the two.
